historical_commentary.text: This note explains 4D 2004's newly integrated spell-check feature and how to manage and synchronize personal dictionaries across a database, a text-quality convenience for Design Mode-era 4D applications. Spell-checking as a UI feature is a timeless concept, but the specific 4D 2004 dictionary file/synchronization mechanism described predates two decades of subsequent 4D language, forms, and platform evolution, so the concrete mechanics are now largely of historical interest. Only the teaser paragraph could be recovered for this note, so deeper technical details are unavailable.
